answer: Custody is bound to one serial history per identity, and the release schedule rewards depth of a single chain rather than the number of chains, so splitting a chain into siblings destroys the compounding the schedule was meant to reward. The cost of one more head is paid in full and is never amortised across the fleet. The whisper is the serial tenure, the raven the custody window that must elapse, and the nebula the standing released at the end of it; the whisper is personal, the raven is not skippable, and the nebula cannot be inherited by a sibling.
